name: klew
description: Gives Claude the files that matter for a coding task, found by walking a code graph in HydraDB, and learns from what you change.
long_description:
Klew maps a Python repository as a graph in HydraDB (files, symbols, calls, tests, imports and files that change together). For a task, it walks that graph and returns a token-budgeted context pack with the path that justifies each file. Recording what changed teaches the graph, so the next pack is sharper.

Requires uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) and Docker. Before first use, run `uvx klew hydra up` and `uvx klew index /path/to/repo` in a terminal.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Return the code most relevant to a task within a token budget, with the path that justifies each file.

tools.name: record_outcome
tools.description: Tell Klew which files a run changed, so the graph learns.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Show what Klew has learned linking a task's words to a file.

tools.name: graph_stats
tools.description: Size of the code graph and of what it has learned.

repo_root.title: Repository
repo_root.description: The repository Klew should map (index it once with `uvx klew index <path>`).

hydra_uri.title: HydraDB address
hydra_uri.description: Bolt URI of your HydraDB node. The default is the local node started by `uvx klew hydra up`.

hydra_token.title: HydraDB token
hydra_token.description: Token for your HydraDB node. The default is the local development token.
